summary: Single Metrocount piezo (counter 209) with two directions, consistent from Dec 2020 to Sep 2026 at a steady North/South ratio of about 0.33. The automatic fixes correctly remove the full-counter outages of 2021-07-25 to 2021-08-16 and 2025-10-19 to 2025-10-21, and a few short northbound drop-outs on rainy or flood days; only the northbound morning of 2021-08-16 is restored. The direction-share shifts in late May 2025 (more northbound) and from 2026-09-07 (southbound halves) match opposite changes on the Silverwater Rd West counter (site 196), so they are riders changing route, not faults.
